title: "Digital request themes (LLM metadata, version 3)"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    code-fold: true
    embed-resources: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
res <- readRDS(here::here("02_data_output", "dig_req_llm_metadata_2.rds"))
flat <- res |>
  mutate(
    summary = map_chr(metadata_v3, ~ .x$summary %||% NA_character_),
    business_area = map_chr(metadata_v3, ~ .x$business_area %||% NA_character_),
    themes = map(metadata_v3, ~ unlist(.x$themes)),
    n_findings_v2 = lengths(findings_v2),
    n_findings_v3 = lengths(findings_v3)
  )
```

## Theme frequencies

```{r}
themes <- flat |> select(request_row_id, themes) |> unnest(themes)
themes |> count(themes, sort = TRUE) |> kable()
```

## Potentially related or duplicate requests

Requests sharing two or more themes.

```{r}
pairs <- inner_join(themes, themes, by = "themes", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(request_row_id.x < request_row_id.y) |>
  group_by(request_row_id.x, request_row_id.y) |>
  summarise(shared_themes = paste(themes, collapse = "; "), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 2) |> arrange(desc(n))
kable(pairs)
```

## Request summaries

```{r}
flat |>
  transmute(request_row_id, business_area, themes = map_chr(themes, paste, collapse = "; "), summary) |>
  kable()
```

## Quality assurance findings

```{r}
flat |>
  transmute(request_row_id,
            findings_v2 = map_chr(findings_v2, paste, collapse = " | "),
            findings_v3 = map_chr(findings_v3, paste, collapse = " | ")) |>
  filter(findings_v2 != "" | findings_v3 != "") |>
  kable()
```
